result: No fixed nonzero globally nonnegative polynomial q(v) gives polynomial two-LMI completions for all valid canonical sources.

bell_operator.standard_frame: Swap Alice inputs; A0=B0=diag(1,-1), A1=c*Z+r*X, B1=e*Z+s*X.

lower_coefficients: [t^j]F=0 for 0<=j<6; only even t powers occur.
limiting_nonsos: For first term q(v)=a*v^(2*k), a>0, t^(-8-2*k)*q(t*y)*(t*x)^2*(1+t^2*x^2)*F tends coefficientwise to 4*a/3*x^2*y^(2*k)*(M(x,y)+2).
unresolved: The half-line quadratic/algebraic selector may still be globally adequate; no global affine lift is asserted.
stronger_result: For each fixed pair of nonzero globally nonnegative polynomials p(u), q(v), p(u)*q(v)*F_c(T) is not polynomial SOS for every sufficiently small T>0 in the stated family.
quantifier_note: The threshold delta_(p,q)>0 is proved to exist; no explicit bound for arbitrary p,q is evaluated. For each fixed t, x,y remain arbitrary independent testing variables.

critical_halfline_gram.scope: Only the critical polynomial M(x,y)+2 on y>=0; not the full canonical slack.
